Initial assessment of abstract-scan hypothesis: Apply Q prediction framework to P RTCC for proactive GPU dispatch. Q provides prediction interfaces, error measures, consistency-robustness mechanisms. P provides reactive completion-triggered execution with measurable latency. Hypothesis: predictions of transmission-completion times could enable proactive rather than reactive dispatch. Need to verify: (1) Does Q actually provide concrete prediction-interface templates applicable to wireless scheduling? (2) Does P current mechanism leave exploitable latency headroom? (3) What prediction horizon makes sense given wireless timescales vs GPU H2D overhead?
